storyCards.headline: Mama Told Me Not To Come: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Three Dog Night's "Mama Told Me Not To Come" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Mama Told Me Not To Come was released in 1971.

"Mama Told Me Not To Come" by Three Dog Night.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
